def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Divider color is the solid separator; repeated pattern is reflected across
    # the vertical axis and copied unchanged into successive horizontal bands.
    sep=next((row[0] for row in grid if len(set(row))==1),None)
    if sep is None:return out
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if all(v==sep for v in grid[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    rs=[0]+[r+1 for r in rows]; re=rows+[H]
    cs=[0]+[c+1 for c in cols]; ce=cols+[W]
    a,b,c,d=rs[0],re[0],cs[0],ce[0]; h=b-a; w=d-c
    for i,(r0,r1) in enumerate(zip(rs,re)):
      for j,(c0,c1) in enumerate(zip(cs,ce)):
        if i==0 and j==0: continue
        for y in range(r0,min(r1,r0+h)):
          for x in range(c0,min(c1,c0+w)):
            sy=a+(y-r0)
            sx=c+(w-1-(x-c0) if j%2 else (x-c0))
            out[y][x]=grid[sy][sx]
    return out
